guidelines.detail: same as LRN-005 (The description states ordered activities and choice-dependent continuations, while the records identify several omitted transitions. This guideline is already covered by learned guideline LRN-005.)

refines FID-03 (The description supports the actions and details reflected in the records, while several generated labels shift or generalize their meaning. This refines the existing guidance to use short, faithful labels by specifying which aspects of the description to preserve. The learned rules also address faithful action and perspective labeling, but do not fully cover this broader object-and-scope emphasis)

documentation rule FID-01 not applied (The description includes customer specifications, production handoffs, testing, protocol delivery, and customer confirmation, while the records identify missing flows across those stages. FID-01 already directs modeling every distinct activity, decision, and outcome stated in the description, so this guideline is already covered.)

same as LRN-070 (The description supports the stated distinctions, while the generated labels differ from the reference in their action, scope, recipient, or direction. This guideline is already essentially stated by learned guideline LRN-070.)

same as LRN-009 (The missing gateway and its outgoing flows indicate that the optional customization choice and its two paths were not modeled. LRN-009 already covers optional work whose paths later continue in common.)

documentation rule FID-03 not applied (The label pairs show differences in actions, objects, scope, or recipients, while the description provides the basis for preserving their meaning. The documented guideline FID-03 already covers using short, faithful labels.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description presents distinct activities in an ordered progression, including transitions into, through, or out of branches or synchronization points: Connect each consecutive activity with a sequence flow, preserving the stated transitions through branches and synchronization points.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description presents activities in an ordered progression, including transitions into, through, or out of branches or synchronization points

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an activity, its object, scope, or recipient: Label the corresponding BPMN element so that it preserves the described action, object, scope, and direction; do not replace them with a related action or add unsupported details.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity, its object, scope, or recipient

rules_sent_back.instruction: Model every distinct activity, event, participant, decision, branch, loop, message and outcome stated in the description. Do not invent process facts.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states distinct activities, decisions, or outcomes that form part of the process

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description presents mutually exclusive alternatives or says an activity may or may not occur, and the paths later continue in common: Model the choice with an exclusive gateway, and reconnect the alternative paths with an exclusive merge before their shared continuation.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a standard offering remains available while customer-specific customization is optional

rules_sent_back.instruction: Use short, faithful labels in the input language. Prefer verb-object activity names and meaningful business triggers or outcomes for events.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity, its object, scope, or recipient
